caption: Game Flow
content: This is a puzzle game where you complete @b{Areas} using the @b{tiles} you have.

content.caption: Unlocking and Completing Areas
content:
Connect roads using your road tiles to unlock new Areas.
Place tiles in an Area and meet all of its conditions to complete it and @b{obtain new tiles}.

If you don't have enough tiles, you won't be able to complete an Area.
@b{Figuring out whether an Area can be completed} is also part of the puzzle.

In this game, it's important not only to @b{solve an Area positively} (by completing it) to obtain new tiles, but also to @b{solve it negatively} (by proving that it cannot be completed), narrowing down the Areas that can be completed.
Because of this, there are more puzzles to solve than it may first appear. Take your time and work through them at your own pace.

content.caption: Clearing the Forest
content:
Tiling Forest is the demo version of Tiling Town, featuring a special Forest stage different from the stages in the full game.
Complete Areas and clear Tiling Forest!

content.caption: Completing the Forest
content: Then, meet all the conditions for completing the Forest to fully clear Tiling Forest!

The puzzles from this point on are more difficult, comparable to @b{the later Towns in the full version of Tiling Town}. If they feel too difficult, you can come back after playing the full version. The full version also includes @b{the Forest stage as a separate bonus mode}, apart from the main Town stages.
